timeline.text: The family calendar lived behind a browser login the kitchen TV could never sign into.
Four brothers all play football under one team name, so a calendar entry couldn't say whose training it was.
Now the server copies every event itself from the calendar's own iCal feed, every fifteen minutes.
Each child gets his own tagged feed, so the right name sticks even when the club renames the team.
Four brothers' football, finally sorted by name, not guesswork.
